clips.title: The story
paras: In Goldshire, Maybell Maclure seeks a way to visit Tommy Joe Stonefield unseen. William Pestle needs rare crystal kelp to brew an invisibility liquor for her.

The feud between the Stonefield and Maclure families keeps Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield from meeting openly. Maybell wants to see her beloved without provoking an armed clash between their kin, so she seeks a way to cross the valley unseen. William Pestle, an herbalist and apothecary at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, plans to brew an invisibility liquor. The rare ingredients he needs are not in the inn's cupboards.

Crystal kelp is the catalyst William Pestle needs for his brew. The fronds usually grow far out in saltwater oceans, but tribal murlocs have carried stashes inland to their crude camps along Crystal Lake, just east of Goldshire. Their peculiar instincts have led them to haul the marine plants to the freshwater shore. You need to recover enough fronds from the murlocs before returning to Goldshire with them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe. But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.
Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... Sometimes murlocs collect it. See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any. Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have that crystal kelp? I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got them. Good show! Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...
